query: UPDATE automations SET name = COALESCE($2, name), schedule = COALESCE($3, schedule), prompt = COALESCE($4, prompt), status = COALESCE(($5::text)::automation_status, status), next_run_at = CASE WHEN $3 IS NULL THEN next_run_at ELSE $6 END, project_id = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE project_id END, kb_ids = COALESCE($9::uuid[], kb_ids), deliver_group_chat_id = CASE WHEN $10 THEN $11 ELSE deliver_group_chat_id END, workspace_id = CASE WHEN $12 THEN $13 ELSE workspace_id END, pre_approved_writes = CASE WHEN $12 AND $13 IS NULL THEN false ELSE COALESCE($14, pre_approved_writes) END, run_when_back = CASE WHEN $12 AND $13 IS NULL THEN false ELSE COALESCE($15, run_when_back) END WHERE id = $1
